title: The Canon of Unbending Law
summary: A canon of law that does not bend to force or argument and ends in a judgment no technique can refuse.

title: Treatise of the Ordained Seal
summary: A treatise on seals laid by ordinance upon bodies and techniques until the seal itself holds the foe.

title: The Grand Ledger Mastery
summary: A mastery of keeping a full account of force given and force owed and calling the whole account due at once.

title: Manual of Absolute Measure
summary: A manual on measuring force without error and meeting every blow with exactly its measure and nothing besides.

title: The Lattice of Necessity
summary: A course in weaving a lattice of order qi in which every motion of a foe is made to follow from the last.

title: The Plumb Mastery
summary: A mastery of the dead vertical line that drops a foe straight down under the weight of an unfailing stroke.

title: Treatise on the Stilled Technique
summary: A treatise on freezing a technique in mid-flight and then dismantling it piece by piece before the foe's eyes.

title: Canon of the Orderly Domain
summary: A canon on a domain in which disorder cannot gather and every force within is made to fall in line.

title: The Regulation Mastery
summary: A mastery of regulating the flow of qi in oneself and in others until no surge or lapse is possible.

title: The Axiom Course
summary: A course built on a handful of first truths of force from which every technique of the school must follow.
